            function t19.SelectTab(p149, p150)
                if p150 == p149.ActiveTab then
                    return
                end

                local ActiveTab = p149.ActiveTab

                p149.ActiveTab = p150

                if ActiveTab then
                    ActiveTab.Page.Visible = false
                    ActiveTab._paintNav(false, false)
                end

                p150.Page.Visible = p149 == p149.Window.ActiveCategory
                p150._paintNav(true, false)
            end

            function t20._disconnectAll(p153)

            function t20._viewportSize(_)
                local CurrentCamera = Workspace2.CurrentCamera
                local v686 = CurrentCamera and CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
                local ok, result, v689 = pcall(function()
                    return GuiService:GetGuiInset()
                end)

                if ok then
                    v686 = Vector2.new(math.max(1, v686.X - result.X - v689.X), math.max(1, v686.Y - result.Y - v689.Y))
                end

                return v686
            end
            function t20._updateResponsiveScale(p155, p156)
                if not p155.RootScale or not p155.DefaultSize then
                    return
                end

                local n2 = 1

                if p155.Responsive then
                    local v693 = p155:_viewportSize()
                    local v694 = p155.ResponsiveMargin or 12
                    local v695 = math.max(1, v693.X - v694 * 2)
                    local v696 = math.max(1, v693.Y - v694 * 2)
                    local v697 = math.min(1, v695 / p155.DefaultSize.X, v696 / p155.DefaultSize.Y)

                    n2 = math.max(0.1, v697)
                end

            function t20.SelectCategory(p157, p158)
                local v700 = type(p158) == "string" and p157.CategoriesByName[p158] or p158

                if not v700 or v700 == p157.ActiveCategory then
                    return
                end

                local ActiveCategory = p157.ActiveCategory

                p157.ActiveCategory = v700

                if ActiveCategory then
                    ActiveCategory._paintChip(false)
                    ActiveCategory.NavFrame.Visible = false

                    local v702 = ActiveCategory.ActiveTab and ActiveCategory.ActiveTab.Page

                    if v702 then
                        v702.Visible = false
                    end
                end

                v700.NavFrame.Visible = true
                v700._paintChip(true)

                if v700.ActiveTab then
                    v700.ActiveTab.Page.Visible = true
                end
            end

            function t20.SetUser(p177, p178)
                local v752 = p178 or {}
                local Name = v752.Name

                if Name == nil or tostring(Name) == "" then
                    Name = LocalPlayer2 and (LocalPlayer2.DisplayName or LocalPlayer2.Name) or "User"
                end

                local Role = v752.Role

                if Role == nil or tostring(Role) == "" then
                    Role = "Cliente Oi"
                end

                local v755 = typeof(v752.RoleColor) == "Color3" and v752.RoleColor or p177.Theme.Cyan
                local v756 = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(v755.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(v755.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(v755.B * 255 + 0.5))
                local v757 = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(p177.Theme.Text.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(p177.Theme.Text.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(p177.Theme.Text.B * 255 + 0.5))
                local v758 = tostring(Name):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")
                local v759 = tostring(Role):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")

                p177.UserName.RichText = true
                p177.UserName.TextColor3 = p177.Theme.TextMuted
                p177.UserName.Text = string.format("Username: <font color=\"%s\">%s</font>", v757, v758)
                p177.UserRole.RichText = true
                p177.UserRole.TextColor3 = p177.Theme.TextMuted
                p177.UserRole.Text = string.format("Role: <font color=\"%s\">%s</font>", v756, v759)

                if type(v752.Avatar) == "string" and v752.Avatar ~= "" then
                    p177.UserAvatar.Image = v752.Avatar

                    return
                end

                if v752.UserId or LocalPlayer2 and LocalPlayer2.UserId then
                    local v760 = tonumber(v752.UserId) or LocalPlayer2.UserId
                    local ok, result = pcall(function()
                        return Players2:GetUserThumbnailAsync(v760, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
                    end)

                    if ok and result then
                        p177.UserAvatar.Image = result
                    end
                end
            end
            function t20.SetVisible(p179, p180)
                if p179._destroyed then
                    return
                end

                local v765 = p180 == true

                p179._targetVisible = v765
                p179._visibilityToken = (p179._visibilityToken or 0) + 1

                local _visibilityToken = p179._visibilityToken

                if p179._visibilityTween then
                    p179._visibilityTween:Cancel()
                end

                if p179._visibilityConnection then
                    p179._visibilityConnection:Disconnect()
                    p179._visibilityConnection = nil
                end

                if v765 then
                    p179.Root.Visible = true
                end

                p179._visibilityTween = TweenService2:Create(p179.Root, tweenInfo4, {
					GroupTransparency = not v765 and 1 or 0
				})

                if p179.RootStroke then
                    v25(p179.RootStroke, tweenInfo4, {
						Transparency = v765 and p179.RootStrokeBase or 1
					})
                end

                if p179.RootShadow and p179.ShadowProp then
                    v25(p179.RootShadow, tweenInfo4, {
						[p179.ShadowProp] = v765 and p179.ShadowBase or 1
					})
                end

                if not v765 then
                    p179._visibilityConnection = p179._visibilityTween.Completed:Connect(function(p181)
                        if p181 == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and (p179._visibilityToken == _visibilityToken and not p179._targetVisible) then
                            p179.Root.Visible = false
                        end

                        if p179._visibilityToken == _visibilityToken then
                            p179._visibilityConnection = nil
                        end
                    end)
                end

                p179._visibilityTween:Play()
            end
            function t20.Toggle(p182)
                p182:SetVisible(not p182._targetVisible)
            end

						TextTransparency = 1,
						TextSize = 13,
						FontFace = font2,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
						TextWrapped = true
					}, v778)
                end

                v25(v775, tweenInfo2, {
					BackgroundTransparency = 0
				})
                v25(v777, tweenInfo2, {
					BackgroundTransparency = 0
				})
                v25(v776, tweenInfo2, {
					Transparency = 0.4
				})

                for _, v in ipairs(t22) do
                    v25(v, tweenInfo2, {
						TextTransparency = 0
					})
                end

                local function v782()
                    if not v775.Parent then
                        return
                    end

                    v25(v775, tweenInfo, {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1
					})
                    v25(v777, tweenInfo, {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1
					})
                    v25(v776, tweenInfo, {
						Transparency = 1
					})

                    for _, v in ipairs(t22) do
                        v25(v, tweenInfo, {
							TextTransparency = 1
						})
                    end

                    task.delay(0.2, function()
                        if v775 and v775.Parent then
                            v775:Destroy()
                        end
                    end)
                end

                task.delay(v772, v782)

                return {
					Instance = v775,
					Dismiss = v782
				}
            end
            function t20.Destroy(p185)
                if p185._destroyed then
                    return
                end

                p185._destroyed = true

                if p185._visibilityTween then
                    p185._visibilityTween:Cancel()
                end

                if p185._visibilityConnection then
                    p185._visibilityConnection:Disconnect()
                end

                p185:_disconnectAll()

                if p185.ScreenGui and p185.ScreenGui.Parent then
                    p185.ScreenGui:Destroy()
                end

                for i, v in ipairs(t1.Windows) do
                    if v == p185 then
                        table.remove(t1.Windows, i)

                        return
                    end
                end
            end

            local function v50(p186, p187)
                local ToggleButtonImage = p187.ToggleButtonImage

				}, p186.ScreenGui)
                v21(v792, 11)
                local v793 = v22(v792, p186.Theme.Border, 0.25, 1)
                local v794 = v20("UIScale", {
					Scale = 1
				}, v792)
                local u795 = false
                local u796 = false
                local u797 = false
                local u798
                local vector2 = Vector2.new()
                local vector2_2 = Vector2.new()
                local v801 = type(ToggleButtonImage) == "string" and (ToggleButtonImage ~= "" and v34(ToggleButtonImage)) or nil
                if v801 then
                    v20("ImageLabel", {
						Name = "Logo",
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v790, v790),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -v790 * 2, 1, -v790 * 2),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Image = v801,
						ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
						ZIndex = 51
					}, v792)
                else
                    v20("TextLabel", {
						Name = "LogoFallback",
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Text = "Oi",
						TextColor3 = p186.Theme.Text,
						TextSize = math.floor(v789 * 0.34),
						FontFace = font3,
						ZIndex = 51
					}, v792)
                end
                p186:_track(v792.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    u795 = true
                    v25(v792, tweenInfo, {
						BackgroundColor3 = p186.Theme.CardHover
					})
                    v25(v793, tweenInfo, {
						Color = p186.Theme.AccentDim,
						Transparency = 0.05
					})
                    v25(v794, tweenInfo, {
						Scale = 1.05
					})
                end))
                p186:_track(v792.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    u795 = false
                    v25(v792, tweenInfo, {
						BackgroundColor3 = p186.Theme.Panel
					})
                    v25(v793, tweenInfo, {
						Color = p186.Theme.Border,
						Transparency = 0.25
					})
                    v25(v794, tweenInfo, {
						Scale = 1
					})
                end))
                p186:_track(v792.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    local UserInputType = input.UserInputType

                    if UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        return
                    end

                    u796 = true
                    u797 = false
                    u798 = UserInputType
                    vector2 = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                    vector2_2 = v792.AbsolutePosition
                    v25(v794, tweenInfo, {
						Scale = 0.94
					})
                end))
                p186:_track(UserInputService2.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if not u796 then
                        return
                    end

                    local UserInputType = input.UserInputType

                    if (u798 ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) and (u798 ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch or UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        return
                    end

                    local v1943 = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - vector2

                    if v1943.Magnitude >= 4 then
                        u797 = true
                    end

                    local v1944 = p186:_viewportSize()
                    local v1945 = math.clamp(vector2_2.X + v1943.X, 8, math.max(8, v1944.X - v789 - 8))
                    local v1946 = math.clamp(vector2_2.Y + v1943.Y, 8, math.max(8, v1944.Y - v789 - 8))

                    v792.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v1945, v1946 + v789 / 2)
                end))
                p186:_track(UserInputService2.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if not u796 then
                        return
                    end

                    local UserInputType = input.UserInputType

                    if (u798 ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and (u798 ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch or UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        return
                    end

                    u796 = false
                    u798 = nil
                    v25(v794, tweenInfo, {
						Scale = not u795 and 1 or 1.05
					})
                end))
                p186:_track(v792.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                    v25(v794, tweenInfo, {
						Scale = 0.94
					})
                end))
                p186:_track(v792.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if u797 then
                        return
                    end

                    v25(v794, tweenInfo, {
						Scale = 1
					})
                    p186:Toggle()
                end))

                return v792
            end

            local t23 = {}

            t23.__index = t23

            function t23._track(p190, p191)
                table.insert(p190._connections, p191)

                return p191
            end
            function t23._viewportSize(p192)
                return t20._viewportSize(p192)
            end
            function t23._updateResponsiveScale(p193, p194)
                if not p193.RootScale or not p193.DefaultSize then
                    return
                end

                local n3 = 1

                if p193.Responsive then
                    local v844 = p193:_viewportSize()
                    local v845 = p193.ResponsiveMargin or 12
                    local v846 = math.min(1, math.max(1, v844.X - v845 * 2) / p193.DefaultSize.X, math.max(1, v844.Y - v845 * 2) / p193.DefaultSize.Y)

                    n3 = math.max(0.1, v846)
                end

                p193.ResponsiveScale = n3
                p193.RootScale.Scale = n3

                if p194 then
                    p193.Root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                end
            end
            function t23.Close(p195)
                if p195._closed then
                    return
                end

                p195._closed = true

                if p195.RootStroke then
                    v25(p195.RootStroke, tweenInfo4, {
						Transparency = 1
					})
                end

                if p195.RootShadow and p195.ShadowProp then
                    v25(p195.RootShadow, tweenInfo4, {
						[p195.ShadowProp] = 1
					})
                end

                local tween = TweenService2:Create(p195.Root, tweenInfo4, {
					GroupTransparency = 1
				})

                tween.Completed:Connect(function()
                    for _, v in ipairs(p195._connections) do
                        pcall(function()
                            v:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end

                    if p195.ScreenGui and p195.ScreenGui.Parent then
                        p195.ScreenGui:Destroy()
                    end
                end)
                tween:Play()
            end

                local function v897(p211)
                    if p211.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p211.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        v869._dragging = true
                        v869._dragStart = p211.Position
                        v869._dragOrigin = v863.AbsolutePosition
                    end
                end

                v869:_track(v863.InputBegan:Connect(v897))
                v869:_track(v874.InputBegan:Connect(v897))
                v869:_track(UserInputService2.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if not v869._dragging then
                        return
                    end

                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        return
                    end

                    local v1996 = input.Position - v869._dragStart
                    local v1997 = v869:_viewportSize()
                    local AbsoluteSize = v863.AbsoluteSize
                    local v1999 = v869.ResponsiveMargin or 8
                    local v2000 = v1997.X - AbsoluteSize.X - v1999
                    local v2001 = v1997.Y - AbsoluteSize.Y - v1999
                    local v2002 = v1999 <= v2000 and math.clamp(v869._dragOrigin.X + v1996.X, v1999, v2000) or math.max(0, (v1997.X - AbsoluteSize.X) / 2)
                    local v2003 = v1999 <= v2001 and math.clamp(v869._dragOrigin.Y + v1996.Y, v1999, v2001) or math.max(0, (v1997.Y - AbsoluteSize.Y) / 2)

                    v863.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v2002 + AbsoluteSize.X / 2, v2003 + AbsoluteSize.Y / 2)
                end))
                v869:_track(UserInputService2.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        v869._dragging = false
                    end
                end))

                return v869
            end
        end

        local function v68()
            local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
            local v920 = t25.alwaysDay or (t25.fullbright or (t25.noShadow or (t25.noFog or t25.noBlur)))

            if not t24.worldOriginal and v920 then
                t24.worldOriginal = {
					Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
					ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
					FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
					FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
					GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
					Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
					OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
					ExposureCompensation = Lighting.ExposureCompensation
				}
            end

            local worldOriginal = t24.worldOriginal

            if not v920 then
                if worldOriginal then
                    for k, v in pairs(worldOriginal) do
                        pcall(function()
                            Lighting[k] = v
                        end)
                    end
                end

                return
            end

            if t25.alwaysDay or t25.fullbright then
                Lighting.ClockTime = 14
            elseif worldOriginal then
                Lighting.ClockTime = worldOriginal.ClockTime
            end

            if t25.fullbright then
                Lighting.Brightness = 2
                Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0
                Lighting.Ambient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            elseif worldOriginal then
                Lighting.Brightness = worldOriginal.Brightness
                Lighting.ExposureCompensation = worldOriginal.ExposureCompensation
                Lighting.Ambient = worldOriginal.Ambient
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = worldOriginal.OutdoorAmbient
            end

            if t25.noShadow or t25.fullbright then
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            elseif worldOriginal then
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = worldOriginal.GlobalShadows
            end

            if t25.noFog or t25.fullbright then
                Lighting.FogStart = 0
                Lighting.FogEnd = 1000000000

                local Atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

                if Atmosphere then
                    Atmosphere.Density = 0
                end
            elseif worldOriginal then
                Lighting.FogStart = worldOriginal.FogStart
                Lighting.FogEnd = worldOriginal.FogEnd
            end

            if t25.noBlur then
                for _, descendant in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("BlurEffect") then
                        descendant.Enabled = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function v148(p272, p273, p274, p275, p276)

            local v1173 = not v1172 and 0.033333333333333 or 0.016666666666667

            p273.nextVisualUpdate = v134(p273.nextVisualUpdate, p276, v1173)

            if p273.arrow then
                p273.arrow.Visible = false
            end

            local huge = math.huge
            local huge2 = math.huge
            local v1176 = -math.huge
            local v1177 = -math.huge
            local v1178 = false
            local t41 = {}
            local t42 = {}

                local vector3_2
                local vector3_3
                for _, v in ipairs(p273.bodyParts) do
                    if Character == v.Parent then
                        local v1185 = v.Size * 0.5
                        local v1186 = v.Position - v1185
                        local v1187 = v.Position + v1185

                        if vector3_2 then
                            vector3_2 = Vector3.new(math.min(vector3_2.X, v1186.X), math.min(vector3_2.Y, v1186.Y), math.min(vector3_2.Z, v1186.Z))
                            vector3_3 = Vector3.new(math.max(vector3_3.X, v1187.X), math.max(vector3_3.Y, v1187.Y), math.max(vector3_3.Z, v1187.Z))
                        else
                            vector3_2 = v1186
                            vector3_3 = v1187
                        end
                    end
                end

                    local n9 = 0

                    for i = 0, 1 do
                        for j = 0, 1 do
                            for k = 0, 1 do
                                n9 += 1

                                local vector3_4 = Vector3.new(i == 0 and vector3_2.X or vector3_3.X, j == 0 and vector3_2.Y or vector3_3.Y, k == 0 and vector3_2.Z or vector3_3.Z)
                                local v1193, _, v1195 = v140(p274, vector3_4)

                                t41[n9] = v1193
                                t42[n9] = v1195

                                if v1195 > 0.5 then
                                    v1178 = true
                                    huge = math.min(huge, v1193.X)
                                    huge2 = math.min(huge2, v1193.Y)
                                    v1176 = math.max(v1176, v1193.X)
                                    v1177 = math.max(v1177, v1193.Y)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if v1178 then
                    local ViewportSize = p274.ViewportSize

                    huge = math.clamp(huge, -32, ViewportSize.X + 32)
                    v1176 = math.clamp(v1176, -32, ViewportSize.X + 32)
                    huge2 = math.clamp(huge2, -32, ViewportSize.Y + 32)
                    v1177 = math.clamp(v1177, -32, ViewportSize.Y + 32)

                    if v1176 - huge < 1 or v1177 - huge2 < 1 then
                        v1178 = false
                    end
                end
            end

            if t25.box and p273.box then

                    p273.box.Size = Vector2.new(v1176 - huge, v1177 - huge2)

                else

                end

                    v1197.From = Vector2.new(ViewportSize.X * 0.5, ViewportSize.Y - 4)
                    v1197.To = v1178 and Vector2.new((huge + v1176) * 0.5, (huge2 + v1177) * 0.5) or v1169
                    v1197.Visible = true
                end
            elseif p273.tracer then
                p273.tracer.Visible = false
            end

            if t25.box3d then
                local v1199 = v143(p273)

                for i, v in ipairs(t39) do
                    local v1202 = v1199[i]
                    local v1203 = t41[v[1]]
                    local v1204 = t41[v[2]]
                    local v1205 = t42[v[1]]

    function v203()

        function u225(p405, p406)
            local v1724 = v221()
            local v1725 = v224(p405.chave)
            local v1726 = p406 and math.max(1, math.floor(p406)) or nil

            if v1724 < p405.preco * (v1726 or 1) then
                return false, "saldo"
            end

            local Mercadinho = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Mercadinho")
            local v1728 = not p405.hpItem and "GlobalComprarItem" or "HPRemote"
            local v1729 = Mercadinho and Mercadinho:FindFirstChild(v1728)

            if not v1729 or not v1729:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                return false, v1728
            end

            if v1726 and not p405.hpItem then
                local v1730 = v307()

                if v1730 then
                    local BRecusar = v1730:FindFirstChild("BRecusar", true)

                    if BRecusar and v61.firesignal then
                        v61.firesignal(BRecusar.MouseButton1Click)
                    else
                        local InGameRemotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("InGameRemotes")
                        local v1733 = InGameRemotes and InGameRemotes:FindFirstChild("MandaTextbox")

                        if v1733 then
                            v1733:FireServer("Response", false)
                        end

                        v1730:Destroy()
                    end

                    task.wait(0.35)
                end
            end

            for _ = 1, not p405.hpItem and 1 or (v1726 or 1) do
                v1729:FireServer(p405.chave)

                if p405.hpItem then
                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end

            if v1726 and not p405.hpItem then
                local v1735 = os.clock() + 3
                local v1736, v1737

                repeat
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    v1736, v1737 = v307()
                until v1736 or t24.destroyed or v1735 <= os.clock()

                if not v1736 then
                    return false, "quantidade"
                end

                local Aceitar = v1736:FindFirstChild("Aceitar", true)

                v1737.Text = tostring(v1726)

                if Aceitar and v61.getconnections then
                    local v1739 = os.clock() + 2

                    repeat
                        task.wait(0.05)
                    until #v61.getconnections(Aceitar.MouseButton1Click) > 0 or v1739 <= os.clock()
                else
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end

                if Aceitar and v61.firesignal then
                    pcall(v61.firesignal, Aceitar.MouseButton1Click)
                    task.wait(0.4)
                end

                if v1736.Parent then
                    local InGameRemotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("InGameRemotes")
                    local v1741 = InGameRemotes and InGameRemotes:FindFirstChild("MandaTextbox")

                    if not v1741 then
                        return false, "quantidade"
                    end

                    v1741:FireServer("Response", v1737.Text)
                    v1736:Destroy()
                end
            end

            local v1742 = false
            local v1743 = os.clock() + 30

            repeat
                if not v1742 and (function()
                    local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                    local v2081 = PlayerGui and PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MsgsUI")
                    local v2082 = v2081 and v2081:FindFirstChild("BGFrame", true)
                    local v2083 = v2082 and v2082:FindFirstChild("Aceitar", true)
                    local v2084 = v2082 and v2082:FindFirstChild("Not", true)

                    if v2083 and (v61.firesignal and v2084 and tostring(v2084.Text):lower():find("comprar")) then
                        pcall(v61.firesignal, v2083.MouseButton1Click)

                        return true
                    end

                    return false
                end)() then
                    v1742 = true
                end

                task.wait(0.15)
            until v1724 > v221() or v1725 < v224(p405.chave) or t24.destroyed or v1743 <= os.clock()

            if t24.destroyed then
                return false, "encerrado"
            end

            if v1724 > v221() or v1725 < v224(p405.chave) then
                return true, v1724 - v221()
            end

            return false, "recusado"
        end

        local function v308(p407)

                return

            local Mercadinho = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Mercadinho")

    local t64 = {
		moved = false,
		kind = nil,
		start = Vector2.new(),
		origin = Vector2.new()
	}

    v67(TextButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        local UserInputType = input.UserInputType

        if UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end

        local v1764 = t64
        local v1765 = t64

        v1764.kind = UserInputType
        v1765.moved = false
        t64.start = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        t64.origin = TextButton.AbsolutePosition
    end))
    v67(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not t64.kind then
            return
        end

        local UserInputType = input.UserInputType

        if (t64.kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) and (t64.kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch or UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            return
        end

        local v1768 = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - t64.start

        if v1768.Magnitude >= 4 then
            t64.moved = true
        end

        local CurrentCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local v1770 = CurrentCamera and CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
        local v1771 = math.clamp(t64.origin.X + v1768.X, 8, math.max(8, v1770.X - TextButton.AbsoluteSize.X - 8))
        local v1772 = math.clamp(t64.origin.Y + v1768.Y, 8, math.max(8, v1770.Y - TextButton.AbsoluteSize.Y - 8))

        TextButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v1771, v1772 + TextButton.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2)
    end))

        u226 = false
    end

    else
        local v335, v336

        do
            local function v333(p422)
                if typeof(p422) == "EnumItem" then
                    return (string.gsub(tostring(p422), "^Enum%.%a+%.", ""))
                end

                return p422 and tostring(p422) or nil
            end
            local function v334(p423)
                if typeof(p423) == "EnumItem" then
                    return p423
                end

                if type(p423) ~= "string" then
                    return nil
                end

                local ok, result = pcall(function()
                    return Enum.KeyCode[p423]
                end)

                if ok and result then
                    return result
                end

                return nil
            end

            function v335()
                local t66 = {}

                for k, v in pairs(t26) do
                    local ok, result = pcall(function()
                        return v:Get()
                    end)

                    if ok then
                        if typeof(result) == "EnumItem" then
                            result = v333(result)
                        end

                        t66[k] = result
                    end
                end

                return t66
            end
            function v336(p424)
                if type(p424) ~= "table" then
                    return
                end

                for k, v in pairs(t26) do
                    local u1810 = p424[k]

                    if u1810 ~= nil then
                        if type(u1810) == "string" and typeof(v:Get()) == "EnumItem" then
                            u1810 = v334(u1810)
                        end

                        if u1810 ~= nil then
                            pcall(function()
                                v:Set(u1810)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

function v61.__KNWARE_SINTONIA_CLEANUP()
    t24.destroyed = true
    v61.__KNWARE_SINTONIA_RUNTIME = nil
    pcall(function()
        if u214 then
            u214:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    t25.espEnabled = false
    t25.highlight = false
    t25.tracer = false
    t25.arrow = false
    t25.box3d = false
    t25.spoofWalkEnabled = false
    t25.spoofJumpEnabled = false
    t25.antiRagdollEnabled = false
    t25.godModeEnabled = false
    pcall(v108, false)
    t25.antiTiroEnabled = false
    pcall(v109, false)
    t25.silentAimEnabled = false
    t25.silentAimFovVisible = false
    t25.bestWeaponEnabled = false
    t24.bestWeaponRunId = t24.bestWeaponRunId + 1
    t25.autoFarmLixeiroEnabled = false
    t24.garbageFarmRunId = t24.garbageFarmRunId + 1
    t25.durabilidadeHudEnabled = false

    if t24.destruirDurabilidade then
        pcall(t24.destruirDurabilidade)
    end

    t25.bestCarsEspEnabled = false

    if t24.destruirBestCarsEsp then
        pcall(t24.destruirBestCarsEsp)
    end

    t25.boostFactor = 1
    table.clear(t24.relationships)
    table.clear(t24.relationshipConnections)
    t25.rolarEnabled = false
    pcall(v101)
    t25.noclipEnabled = false
    pcall(v96)
    t25.flyEnabled = false
    pcall(v98)
    pcall(v155)
    pcall(function()
        if u156 then
            u156:Remove()
        end
    end)
    pcall(v90)
    pcall(function()
        local v2090 = v72()

        if v2090 then
            v84(v2090, false)
            v2090:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
        end

        local v2091 = v83()

        if v2091 then
            v2091.Disabled = false
        end
    end)

    for _, v in ipairs(t24.connections) do
        pcall(function()
            v:Disconnect()
        end)
    end

    t24.connections = {}

    for k, v in pairs(t25.bundles) do
        v138(v)
        t25.bundles[k] = nil
    end

    pcall(function()
        local v2092 = v72()

        if v2092 then
            local v2093 = v73()

            if v2093 then
                v2092:MoveTo(v2093.Position)
            end

            v2092.WalkSpeed = 16
            v2092.JumpPower = 50
        end
    end)
end
return true
